Seahawks Fan Zone

Privacy Policy

Privacy, cookies, and advertising choices

Last updated: September 13, 2026

Who operates this site

Seahawks Fan Zone is an independent fan publication operated by an individual site owner. For privacy questions or requests, use the Contact page.

Information we use

You can read the site without creating an account. We do not maintain a visitor profile database or collect payment details, ticket-account credentials, or precise location. The website does not record custom browsing or ticket-click analytics or save marketing attribution in your browser.

Delivering a website still involves processing information. Our server and providers can receive your IP address, requested page, browser information, request time, and referring page. Hosting and security systems may keep diagnostic logs. We do not use those logs to build advertising profiles.

Google advertising

Google AdSense ads are not currently enabled on this site. We may use a public publisher verification tag and ads.txt record while applying; those records do not themselves load advertising or set cookies. The advertising practices below describe the nonpersonalized service we plan to use when advertising is enabled.

Google's advertising services generally allow Google and other vendors to use cookies for ads based on prior visits to this or other websites. Our advertising setup requests that personalization be disabled. See How Google uses information from partner sites, Google's Privacy Policy, Google Ads Settings, and YourAdChoices. When advertising is enabled, Google's consent controls identify participating vendors and link to their information.

Cloudflare delivery, security, and aggregate statistics

Cloudflare helps deliver and protect this site and may process request information and security cookies to prevent abuse. Cloudflare may also provide aggregate traffic and performance statistics through Web Analytics. That browser beacon does not use cookies, local storage, or persistent visitor identifiers. Cloudflare states that it discards the network IP address received by that analytics service at the receiving data center. Cloudflare's separate delivery and security services and our server may still process or log IP addresses.

See Cloudflare's Web Analytics data description, Cloudflare's Privacy Policy, and Cloudflare's cookie information.

Cookies and browser storage

  • Security: Cloudflare may use cookies for security, challenges, and abuse prevention.
  • Privacy choices: When advertising is enabled, Google's consent service may store your choices on your device. We do not maintain a separate consent database or custom consent cookie.
  • Advertising: When permitted, Google and participating providers may use cookies or similar storage for delivery, frequency limits, measurement, and fraud prevention, including for nonpersonalized ads.
  • Display preferences: Any preferences retained by site features stay in your browser and are not sent to us as visitor profiles.

Your privacy choices

Privacy Choices opens Google's privacy controls when advertising and the consent service are available. You can review vendors, decline optional consent, or change a previous decision. Applicable US choices include opting out of sale or sharing of personal information and targeted advertising through Google's controls. Our ad loader also treats a browser Global Privacy Control signal as a request not to load ads.

If advertising is disabled or the consent service cannot load, the link returns to this section and does not save a preference. You can also clear or block cookies using your browser. Blocking advertising does not block site access. Stopping future requests cannot undo processing that already occurred; provider privacy pages explain further access and deletion options.

External links and affiliate relationships

Ticket and other external links take you to independent providers. Links may contain public campaign or affiliate identifiers. Those providers receive ordinary web request information and manage purchases and later activity under their own privacy policies. We do not collect ticket-account or payment information. See our advertising and affiliate disclosure.

Contact messages and retention

If you email us, your address and message are processed by our email provider and available to the site owner for responding. Do not include payment details or other sensitive information. Provider retention and deletion practices are described in their privacy policies. The site owner remains responsible for information under our control. Contact us about access, correction, or deletion of information you have sent us.

Children

This publication is intended for a general football audience and is not directed to children under 13. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us so we can address it.
